title: About Black Pearl Painters
desc: About us: We want to do more than paint your home or business! It is our goal to provide a level of service that goes above and beyond.

blocks.text: We want to do more than paint your home or business! It is our goal to provide a level of service that goes above and beyond. Our customers keep coming back to us for a reason – we live up to our promises and treat our customers’ homes as we would want ours to be treated. Black Pearl Painters is a local, family-owned business. Our customers are our neighbors, and the community we serve is the place we call home. We have built our clientele and our reputation by providing exceptional service for decades. These attributes include:
We are licensed, bonded, and insured with reliable employees. Our reputation in our community is important to us, and we will always provide honest service.

Our strategic methods allow us to provide quality workmanship with every project we complete. As a family-owned company, we’re a tight-knit team that works together for efficiency and expertise you can count on.
We guarantee our customers’ satisfaction – on most of our jobs, we do not collect a dime until we are 100% completed (including final touch-ups). We stand by all of our work!

Our prices are competitive! We measure all of our projects and plug those numbers into our pricing program to ensure we are fair and accurate on every job. You can be sure you get the most value for your investment.

We seek to build positive relationships with homeowners, tenants, and businesses in our community. As a family-owned business, we take a personal approach and believe in fostering connections that go beyond the job.

Whether you need new paint inside or outside of your home or an entire warehouse, we are your trusted source for quality workmanship. Get to know us by calling to get an estimate the next time you are planning a new painting project.
